NORMAL.label: Normal
NORMAL.desc: Descend, survive, fight, explore, decide. The ones before you already cleared some of the traps; the price is that you meet more of the creatures.

RELAXED.label: Relaxed
RELAXED.desc: Normal is a bit too much?

PARADISE.label: Paradise
PARADISE.desc: A good way to learn the game... or to take it easy.

FREEFALL.label: Freefall
FREEFALL.desc: Take a break. Full lighting, endless magazines, lucky blocks, almost no fall damage, and creatures from every direction. Shoot, reload, see how long you last.
